decisions.reason: As the flagship transactional email service aligned with the firm's multichannel cloud direction in a growing industry, it likely meets aspirations, and the lack of website evidence for 2020-2021 is not enough to trigger problemistic search.

Document capture supports the electronic document workflow strategy and the hiring firm has slack to carry it, though its absence from the website in 2020-2021 raises some doubt about whether it meets aspirations.
The feature is cheap to maintain and tied to the established fax business, but declining fax demand and the earlier withdrawal of the fax conversion service make a later consolidation plausible.
Rising ransomware and phishing threats keep demand high among regulated customers, so sandbox protection likely meets aspirations and strengthens the security portfolio.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a low-cost standard part of the core secure messaging offer, so dropping it would release few resources and weaken the core service.
